metadata.name: card_flex
metadata.description: Card Flex Teen Patti program (Solana base layer + MagicBlock PER)

instructions.name: abort_lost_hand
docs: CF-053 (ADR 0004 #8): ends a hand whose secret state was lost, e.g. a
PER restart that kept the delegated runtime but not the ephemeral
accounts. Permissionless. `remaining_accounts` = every ephemeral
account the hand needs: the dealer, then the seat hands, then the
salts of the dealt seats in dealing order. It succeeds only if at
least one of them is gone. Those accounts can't be closed while a hand
is in progress, so a missing one can only mean lost state; and since
they are private, only the program (not an RPC reader) can tell, which
is why a keeper simply tries this when a hand is stuck. Nothing is
redealt and the hand is counted in `cancelled_hands`. Before
settlement no stack has moved (boots live in `game` until the hand
ends). A hand settled but not yet revealed can never be verified, so
its result is reversed: stacks go back to the start of the hand and
its rake is taken back. No sync copies stacks or rake mid-hand, so
nothing was paid from that result.

instructions.name: act
docs: One player action during betting (CF-020). Signed by the acting seat's
session key; `expected_seq` must equal the current `action_seq`, so a
stale or replayed action fails. Rules come only from
`teen-patti-core`; on settlement the stacks and rake are written back
and the hand becomes `HAND_COMPLETE`.

accounts.name: hand_log
docs: Public action log (CF-021).

instructions.name: apply_top_up
docs: CF-076: anyone (the keeper) credits a seat's deposited top-up to its
stack, between hands only. Moves exactly `buy_in - credited` of this
sit-down (epoch), once: afterwards `credited == buy_in`. A stale PER
clone of the ledger can only show less (deposits only grow within a
sit-down), never more.

instructions.name: buy_in
docs: A wallet takes a seat and moves its buy-in into the table vault.
Base layer, before delegation (the runtime must still be owned by this
program, which Anchor checks). P6 adds re-buys and cash-out.

instructions.name: cancel_buy_in
docs: Refunds a buy-in that never joined (ADR 0005). Only while the runtime
is on the base layer and owned by this program: then the base copy is
the truth, and no join in PER can race the refund, and only if the
table was never delegated. Signed by the recorded wallet (no one else
can cancel a player's buy-in); closes the ledger.

accounts.name: wallet
docs: The payout wallet recorded at buy-in (`has_one`) must sign.

instructions.name: cancel_hand
docs: Cancels a hand whose VRF callback hasn't arrived within
`VRF_TIMEOUT_SLOTS`. Permissionless. The cancellation is counted
publicly, the hand number moves on (so a late callback is rejected and
the next hand has new salts), and nothing is rerolled silently.
Boots are returned with the money logic in P6.

instructions.name: cancel_salts
docs: Ends a salt round that stalled (CF-050): after `salts_deadline`, anyone
may call it. No boots were collected yet (that happens at the deal), so
nothing is owed. Each dealt player who didn't submit a salt gets a
strike; after MAX_MISSED_SALTS in a row they're made to leave (cash-out
after the next sync), so an absent player can't freeze the table but a
briefly slow one isn't evicted.
The hand number moves on, so the next hand has a new context and new
salts. Without this, one absent player froze the table and everyone's
money with it.

instructions.name: cash_out
docs: Pays a seat that has left (ADR 0005 decision 4): its `synced_stack`,
set by `sync_hand` from the committed runtime, to the wallet recorded
at buy-in. Closes the ledger, so it can't be paid twice. Anyone may
submit it; it works while paused and after a refund.

instructions.name: check_vault
docs: Reconciles the vault (ADR 0005 decision 8, PRD §10.4.1):
`vault = rent-exempt minimum + Σ synced_stack + (synced_rake − rake_swept)`.
Fails if the vault holds less (insolvent). `strict` also fails on any
surplus (lamports sent straight to the vault). Read-only; anyone.

instructions.name: claim_refund
docs: Pays one seat its last synced stack after `emergency_refund`, to the
wallet recorded at buy-in. Anyone may call it; each seat is
independent, so one failing payout can't lock the others.

instructions.name: close_ephemeral
docs: Closes an ephemeral account (dealer or a seat hand) and its permission,
returning rent to `TableRuntime`. Must run before `undelegate_table`.

instructions.name: close_salt
docs: Closes a seat's `SaltAccount` and its permission (before undelegate).

instructions.name: commit_hand
docs: Commits `TableRuntime` and `HandLog` to the base layer without
undelegating. Anyone may call it (keeper heartbeat / end of hand).

accounts.name: magic_fee_vault
docs: table's delegated runtime PDA pays the commit (program-signed); without
it MagicBlock allows only 10 commits per account. Checked in the handler.

instructions.name: configure_table
docs: Sets buy-in limits and the refund timeout. Only before anyone has
bought in, so players always see the terms they joined under.

instructions.name: create_table
docs: Creates `TableConfig`, `TableRuntime`, `HandLog` and the vault, and
pre-funds the runtime with the ephemeral rent it will spend inside PER.

instructions.name: deal_hand
docs: Shuffles from the private seed (spec §5–6), commits the deck with a
Merkle root (spec §7), and writes each seat's 3 cards, positions, leaf
salts and proofs into its private `SeatHand` (spec §8). Only the root
becomes public.

accounts.name: dealer
docs: checked in the handler (`stamped`), no PDA re-derivation.

instructions.name: delegate_table
docs: Delegates `TableRuntime` to the TEE validator. Never auto-commits
(ADR 0002 rule 1).

instructions.name: emergency_refund
docs: ADR 0004 rule 5: after `refund_timeout_secs` without an accepted
sync, anyone switches the table to REFUNDED. No cooperation from PER
or the operator. Payouts are then claimed per seat (`claim_refund`).

instructions.name: init_global
docs: Creates the program-wide settings once (ADR 0005). Only the program's
upgrade authority can sign it.

instructions.name: join_seat
docs: Seats a bought-in ledger (ADR 0005 decision 2). Permissionless: the
ledger alone decides who sits and with what. Between hands only.

instructions.name: leave_seat
docs: A player asks to leave (ADR 0005 decision 3), signed by the seat's
session key or wallet. Between hands it applies at once; during a hand
the player finishes it and `next_hand` applies it.

instructions.name: migrate_runtime
docs: CF-067: grows a runtime made by an earlier program version to the
current layout. The appended fields start at zero, which is their
correct default (no paid commit yet, no keeper key). Permissionless:
it changes no game or money state. Base layer only: a delegated
runtime is owned by the delegation program and fails the owner check.

accounts.name: runtime
docs: delegated); its layout is checked in the handler.

instructions.name: next_hand
docs: Moves to the next hand once this one is revealed (CF-024).
Permissionless. The button moves to the seat dealt first this hand;
`hand_no` goes up, so every account of the old hand (salts, seat
hands, VRF) is stale for the new one. Stacks stay as settled; a keeper
commits and syncs them (`commit_hand`, `sync_hand`) between hands.

instructions.name: open_dealer
docs: Creates the ephemeral `DealerState`. Its only permission member is the
`TableRuntime` PDA, which can't sign, so no one can read it.

instructions.name: open_hand_log_permission
docs: Gives `HandLog` an explicit permission marking it **public** (ADR 0002:
never rely on the default for a delegated account).

instructions.name: open_runtime_permission
docs: Makes `TableRuntime` readable only by the table authority and the
seated session keys.

instructions.name: open_salt
docs: Creates the ephemeral `SaltAccount` for a seat. Its only permission
member is the `TableRuntime` PDA, so nobody (not even the player) can
read a salt back; only the program uses it (ADR 0002).

instructions.name: open_seat_hand
docs: Creates the ephemeral `SeatHand` for an occupied seat, readable only by
that seat's session key.

instructions.name: request_shuffle
docs: Requests MagicBlock VRF once every dealt seat has a salt. `caller_seed`
= `vrf_caller_seed(hand_ctx, c_0..c_n)` (spec §3), computed here.

accounts.name: dealer
docs: handler (`stamped`).

instructions.name: reveal_hand
docs: Publishes a finished hand's seed inputs (spec §9) in `HandLog`: roster,
salts, VRF output, commitments and root. Permissionless. Salts are
re-checked against their commitments. After this, anyone can rebuild
the deck, so it runs only after the game has ended the hand.

accounts.name: dealer
docs: checked in the handler (`stamped`), no PDA re-derivation.

instructions.name: rotate_session
docs: The seat's wallet replaces its session key (e.g. a lost or expired
key). Rebuilds the seat hand's reader list and the runtime's member list
so the old key loses access at once.

instructions.name: set_hand_readers
docs: Resets a seat hand's reader list to its own session key (CF-007).
Revoke only since CF-022: grants come only from an accepted Side Show
(`side_show_view`), never from the operator or a player's choice.

instructions.name: set_keeper
docs: CF-065: the table authority names the keeper's read key (or clears it
with the default key). The keeper then reads `TableRuntime` with its
own PER login; it is never a reader of hands, salts or the dealer.

instructions.name: side_show_view
docs: CF-022: Side Show view. `grant`: after an accepted Side Show between
`seat_a` and `seat_b` in the current hand, each may read the other's
hand (reader list = own session + this hand's Side Show opponents).
Only the game can create the pair, so neither the operator nor a
player can choose a viewer. `!grant`: once the hand is no longer being
played, reset both lists to the owner only (needed before the next
`start_hand`). Permissionless: anyone may crank it.

instructions.name: start_hand
docs: Starts the salt round: fixes the dealing order and roster and computes
`hand_ctx` (CF-Fairness v2 spec §2). Dealing order: clockwise from the
seat left of the button, seats with stack >= boot only (CF-024).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone (CF-050): starting a hand needs no privilege, so a keeper holds
no table key and an operator can't stall a table by not starting it.

instructions.name: submit_salt
docs: A seat's session key submits its secret salt once per hand. The salt
goes to the private `SaltAccount`; only `c_i` (spec §3) is public.

instructions.name: sweep_rake
docs: Pays rake to the treasury (ADR 0005 decision 6): only rake of hands
that were committed and synced (`synced_rake`), each lamport once.
Permissionless; allowed while paused and after a refund.

instructions.name: sync_global_authority
docs: CF-055: makes the program's CURRENT upgrade authority the settings
authority. Without it `GlobalConfig.authority` could never change, so
moving control to a Squads multisig (CF-056) was impossible. The
handover is: `solana program set-upgrade-authority` to the multisig,
then the multisig sends this once. Only that key can sign it.

instructions.name: sync_hand
docs: Accepts newer committed runtime state (ADR 0004 rule 4): refreshes
the liveness clock, and between hands copies stacks into the ledgers.

accounts.name: runtime
docs: delegation record are checked in the handler (ADR 0004).

instructions.name: timeout_turn
docs: Turn timer (CF-023, rules v1 §3: 25 s). After `turn_deadline` anyone
may call this: it applies `Timeout` for the player to act (= Pack) or
for a pending Side Show's target (= reject), through the same rules
engine and public log as `act`. A keeper cranks it; players need not.

instructions.name: top_up
docs: CF-076 (ADR 0005 amendment): the seat's wallet adds chips to its
current sit-down. The lamports go to the vault and count at once in
`synced_stack` (cash-out and refunds pay them back even if they never
reach the table) and in `buy_in` (= all deposits); `apply_top_up` puts
them in the stack between hands. At least one boot; the last synced
stack plus the top-up may not exceed the table's maximum buy-in.

accounts.name: runtime
docs: read: top-ups need the CF-076 layout (`credited`).

instructions.name: undelegate_table
docs: Commits `TableRuntime` and returns it to the base layer.

accounts.name: magic_fee_vault
docs: table's delegated runtime PDA pays the commit (program-signed); without
it MagicBlock allows only 10 commits per account. Checked in the handler.

instructions.name: update_global
docs: Changes treasury, rake cap or pause. A lower rake cap applies to
tables configured afterwards; pausing never blocks withdrawals.

instructions.name: vrf_deal
docs: VRF callback. Only the scoped VRF identity can call it, and only while
the hand waits for randomness, so a second or stale fulfilment fails.
Derives `seed` (spec §4) from the VRF output and every salt, and stores
both in the private `DealerState`. The shuffle itself is CF-011.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

accounts.name: dealer
docs: checked in the handler (`stamped`), no PDA re-derivation.

types.name: GameSeat
docs: One seat of the on-chain copy of `teen_patti_core::game::Hand`.

types.name: GameState
docs: On-chain copy of the rules engine's hand state (CF-020). Public: it holds
stacks, bets and turns, never cards.

fields.name: phase
docs: 0 betting, 1 side show pending, 2 over.

fields.name: end_reason
docs: Settlement (valid when phase = 2): 0 last player, 1 show, 2 pot limit.

types.name: GlobalConfig
docs: Program-wide settings (ADR 0005 decision 7). Base layer, never delegated.

fields.name: authority
docs: May change these settings. Set at init to the program's upgrade
authority (a multisig before mainnet).

fields.name: treasury
docs: Receives swept rake.

fields.name: max_rake_bps
docs: Highest `rake_bps` a table may set (≤ `MAX_RAKE_BPS`).

fields.name: paused
docs: Blocks new tables and new buy-ins. Never blocks cash-out, refunds or
rake sweeps.

types.name: HandLog
docs: Public record of the last revealed hand (ADR 0002 `HandLog`, spec §9).
Delegated with the runtime, committed back to Solana with it. Everything
here is public by design: it is what any verifier needs.

fields.name: seats
docs: Seat indices in dealing order.

fields.name: wallets
docs: Wallets in dealing order.

fields.name: salts
docs: Salts in dealing order (revealed).

fields.name: salt_commitments
docs: Commitments in dealing order.

fields.name: boot
docs: Written at reveal: rules, starting stacks and the result, in dealing
order. The verifier replays `actions` from `start_stacks` on the
rebuilt deck and must arrive at exactly this result.

fields.name: winners
docs: Bit i = seat index i won.

types.name: SeatLedger
docs: One per bought-in seat. `synced_stack` is the only amount the base layer
will ever pay out for this seat (ADR 0004).

fields.name: wallet
docs: Payout address, fixed at buy-in.

fields.name: epoch
docs: Sit-down this ledger belongs to; stacks are copied only between a
ledger and a runtime seat with the same epoch.

fields.name: session_key
docs: Session key the player chose at buy-in; `join_seat` installs it.

fields.name: left
docs: Set by `sync_hand` once the committed runtime shows the seat left.

fields.name: validator
docs: Validator the runtime was delegated to (checked by `sync_hand`).

fields.name: seated
docs: Bit i set = seat i has a `SeatLedger` (bought in).

fields.name: last_sync_time
docs: Liveness clock: base-layer time of the last accepted `sync_hand`.

fields.name: seat_epochs
docs: Sit-downs per seat; a new `SeatLedger` gets `seat_epochs[s] + 1`.

fields.name: wallets
docs: Payout wallet of each seat with a ledger (duplicate-wallet check).

fields.name: sessions
docs: Session key chosen at each seat's buy-in (collision check; a later
`rotate_session` in PER is checked there by `is_valid_new_session`).

fields.name: ever_delegated
docs: Set by the first `delegate_table`. From then on PER may hold a clone
of any ledger, so `cancel_buy_in` is never allowed again.

fields.name: synced_rake
docs: CF-033: `TableRuntime.rake_owed` as last synced (between hands).

fields.name: rake_swept
docs: Rake already paid to the treasury.

fields.name: occupied
docs: Bit i set = seat i occupied.

fields.name: session_keys
docs: Per-seat session keys; the only readers of each seat's hand.

fields.name: locked
docs: Set once permissions are built; no seat changes afterwards.

fields.name: grants
docs: Bit i set = seat i's hand currently has a second (Side Show) reader.

fields.name: phase
docs: CF-Fairness v2 state for the current hand (public, never secret).

fields.name: salts_in
docs: Bit i set = seat i has submitted its salt this hand.

fields.name: dealing_order
docs: Seats in dealing order for this hand, `dealing_count` entries.

fields.name: salt_commitments
docs: `c_i` per seat index (spec §3); zero until submitted.

fields.name: vrf_caller_seed
docs: `caller_seed` sent with the VRF request (spec §3), public for audit.

fields.name: merkle_root
docs: Deck commitment (spec §7), public once dealt.

fields.name: vrf_request_slot
docs: Slot of the VRF request; `cancel_hand` is allowed after
`VRF_TIMEOUT_SLOTS` without a callback.

fields.name: cancelled_hands
docs: Hands cancelled at this table (public, for selective-abort monitoring).

fields.name: stacks
docs: Chip stacks per seat index, in lamports (ADR 0004; betting in P5).

fields.name: commit_seq
docs: Bumped by every `commit_hand`; `sync_hand` accepts only newer ones.

fields.name: rake_owed
docs: Rake collected and not yet swept to the treasury (P6).

fields.name: action_seq
docs: Bumped by every accepted `act`; callers pass the value they expect.

fields.name: side_show_viewers
docs: CF-022: `side_show_viewers[s]` bit j = seat j's session may read seat
s's hand this hand (granted by an accepted Side Show only).

fields.name: side_show_hand_no
docs: Hand the viewers belong to.

fields.name: turn_deadline
docs: CF-023: unix time after which `timeout_turn` may act for the player to
act (or the Side Show target). Reset by every action except See.

fields.name: button
docs: CF-024: dealing starts with the first dealt seat after the button.
Starts at `max_seats - 1` (first hand deals from seat 0); `next_hand`
moves it to the seat that was dealt first.

fields.name: seat_epoch
docs: ADR 0005: epoch of the sit-down at each seat (0 = never joined).

fields.name: leaving
docs: CF-032: seats that asked to leave; applied between hands.

fields.name: departed
docs: Seats that left; their final stack stays in `stacks` until the
matching ledger is cashed out and a new epoch joins.

fields.name: salts_deadline
docs: CF-050: unix time after which `cancel_salts` may end a stalled salt round.

fields.name: missed_salts
docs: Salt rounds each seat missed in a row (reset by submitting or joining).

fields.name: last_hand_end
docs: Unix time the last hand ended or was cancelled (HAND_GAP_SECS).

fields.name: last_paid_commit
docs: CF-064: unix time of the last commit the runtime paid for (fee vault).

fields.name: paid_commit_hash
docs: CF-064: `runtime_state_hash` at that commit.

fields.name: keeper
docs: CF-065: the keeper's own read key (default = none). A member of the
runtime permission only: it reads table state, never cards, salts or
the seed. Set by the table authority with `set_keeper`.

fields.name: credited
docs: CF-076 (ADR 0005 amendment): per seat, how much of its ledger's
`buy_in` (= everything deposited this sit-down: buy-in + top-ups) is
already in `stacks`. `join_seat` sets it to the buy-in; `apply_top_up`
adds the difference to the stack between hands; `sync_hand` pays a
difference not applied yet on top of the stack, so a deposit is never
lost or counted twice.

types.name: TableVault
docs: Holds every lamport of the table (ADR 0002/0004). Never delegated.
